latex: \textbf{Example 9.2}\quad \text{Write chemical equations for the following conversions:}\\ \text{(i)\ } \mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-Cl} \text{ into } \mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-NH_2}\\ \text{(ii)\ } \mathrm{C_6H_5-CH_2-Cl} \text{ into } \mathrm{C_6H_5-CH_2-CH_2-NH_2}\\ \underline{\textbf{Solution}}\\ \text{(i)}\quad \mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-Cl} \xrightarrow{\text{Ethanolic NaCN}} \mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-C\equiv N} \xrightarrow{\text{reduction}} \mathrm{CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-NH_2}\\ \text{Chloroethane}\qquad\text{Propanenitrile}\qquad\text{Propan-1-amine}\\ \text{(ii)}\quad \mathrm{C_6H_5-CH_2-Cl} \xrightarrow{\text{Ethanolic NaCN}} \mathrm{C_6H_5-CH_2-C\equiv N} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H_2/Ni}} \mathrm{C_6H_5-CH_2-CH_2-NH_2}\\ \text{Chlorophenylmethane}\ \text{(Benzyl chloride)}\qquad\text{Phenylethanenitrile}\ \text{(Benzyl cyanide)}\qquad\text{2-Phenylethanamine}
